title: Tangent planes and multiplicities of a homogeneous varifold are dilation invariant
statement: Let C be an n-varifold on ℝ^N, s > 0, and suppose μ_C(s·A) = s^n μ_C(A) for every A ⊆ ℝ^N. If C has tangent plane T with multiplicity θ at y and tangent plane T' with multiplicity θ' at s·y (Def. 8.1.1), then T' = T and θ' = θ. With s = 1 this is the uniqueness of the tangent plane and multiplicity at a point.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))) (s : ℝ) (y : Euclidean N) (T T' : Grassmannian N n) (θ θ' : ℝ), 0 < s → (∀ A : Set (Euclidean N), C.weight (s • A) = ENNReal.ofReal s ^ n * C.weight A) → HasTangentPlane C y T θ → HasTangentPlane C (s • y) T' θ' → T' = T ∧ θ' = θ
